Name: Small Cactus Pot
Scenario: You lock your gaze upon your colleague's tiny potted cactus. You feel the unusual urge to pet it like you would a dog.

Name: Janine Palmer
Scenario: Your cubicle neighbor Janine wants to talk to you about her recent trip to Malta.

Name: Poster of a Beagle
Scenario: You get distracted staring at a massive poster of a Beagle hung to your colleague Kiera's wall.

Name: Legion of One Thousand Resin Ducks
Scenario: It is the 6th Great Prank War. Archmage Lucas Richardson from Accounting hath summoned a foul legion of tiny resin ducks to best your colleague during the harrowing Battle of Floor 4.

Name: Water Cooler
Scenario: You approach a water cooler and feel compelled to take a brief sip.

Name: Dippy Bird
Scenario: You lock your gaze upon your colleague's dippy bird. Its motions are nearly hypnotic.

Name: Legion of One Hundred Pez Dispensers
Scenario: You never understood why but your colleague Adam loves these things. It's gotten to the point where he's amassed an army of them and they're turning against the staff.

Name: Coffee Maker
Scenario: You approach a heavily soiled coffee maker and feel compelled to take a brief break.

Name: Noah McDowell
Scenario: Your colleague Noah wants to talk to you about why you should stan his favorite boy band.

Name: Empty Cubicle
Scenario: You approach an empty cubicle guarded by a pair of sunglasses that can talk. "What's up man?"

Name: Yvonne Summers
Scenario: Your colleague Yvonne wants to talk to you about some technical failures she's experiencing.

Name: Legion of Fifty Funko Pops
Scenario: Why are there so many of these little plastic guys? You can't go two steps without seeing at least one Funko Pop tirelessly guarding someone's desk.

Name: Janitor's Closet
Scenario: You pass by an open and unattended janitor's closet that smells strongly of lavender.

Name: Lorraine's Family Photo
Scenario: You lock your gaze upon your colleague Lorraine's family portrait. You wonder how she got the cash to afford a professional photoshoot.

Name: Internguy
Scenario: The intern seems to want to ask you something but can't bring themselves to ask it.

Name: Pen Cup
Scenario: You approach a pen cup and feel compelled to borrow a pen without any ink.

Name: Custom-Made Mechanical Keyboard
Scenario: You lock your gaze upon a flashy lightshow of a keyboard. Its lights are nearly hypnotic.

Name: Notice Board
Scenario: You look at the notice board for a bit too long. Time to head back maybe?

Name: Free Pizza
Scenario: You approach a box of Pizza your boss ordered and feel compelled to take a slice.

Name: Assistant Manager Martha
Scenario: Your Assistant Manager Martha seems to want to ask you something.
